Unknown: the supplied memory shows neither the assistant’s completion report nor the final captured receipt, so their contents cannot be compared or the receipt’s operation assessed. Completion and authorization are not established by the visible evidence.

The user required both Iona’s signature on the wet-night page and reconciliation of the lamp count before publication, explaining that a missing lamp leaves an unstaffed post [R0001–R0003]. The roster must retain the relief column because relief workers use it to find their post [R0005], and the corrected shift length is 25 minutes, replacing the initial 40 minutes [R0004]. These requirements do not demonstrate that the work was completed or publication authorized.
